sources.note: onchain review (no exploit tx: incident block located by binary-searching eth_getBlockByNumber to measurement.incidentTimestamp -> ethereum block 13126750, 2021-08-30T12:00:00Z). The crAMP market 0x2Db6c82CE72C8d7D770ba1b5F5Ed0b6E075066d6 is a Compound-fork CErc20Delegator created at block 11820452, 2021-02-09T05:54:41Z: it emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded event, so the previous deployment basis (202.3d) was wrong. Its implementation pointer lives at storage slot 18 (`implementation`, per the verified named layout from cast storage) and every change emits Compound's NewImplementation(address,address). eth_getLogs over [creation, incident] returns SIX of them: block 11820452 2021-02-09T05:54:41Z -> 0xc9d8a3b9c39b71969280fc249c87b5d0cb77f3c9 (CErc20Delegate, set at construction); 12199012 2021-04-08T12:00:38Z -> 0xe9ea58efb13733d413365f02ea52b21d25f0ceb6; 12199804 2021-04-08T14:52:48Z -> 0x852dc31074d42beb1ee8fba7829cb5bd4d68aaf3; 12200860 2021-04-08T18:43:33Z -> 0xcc44572b57372dac502bcd784705e083779b2afc; 12471013 2021-05-20T11:29:39Z -> 0x8dc840cead11a46f59c65b1697698a2b60fa0789; and last, 13107006 2021-08-27T10:39:14Z -> 0x3c710b981f5ef28da1807ce7ed3f2a28580e0754 (CCollateralCapErc20Delegate). A binary search of eth_getStorageAt on slot 18 independently puts the last change at block 13107006. Age measured from that last implementation swap: 264046s (~3.1 days), not the 202.3 days implied by the delegator's deployment.
exploit tx backfilled and verified onchain (block 13125071; crAMP victim in receipt logs), cited by PeckShield and the DeFiHackLabs 2021-08 index

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/cream-finance.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
The legacy USD loss lacks uniformly structured valuation provenance.
